result.title: Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning with Multi-Branch Exploration
result.summary: Multimodal large language models have made substantial progress in visual question answering, but complex visual reasoning often requires locating and comparing multiple pieces of question-relevant visual evidence. Existing methods that move intermediate reasoning into the visual latent space usually follow a single linear reasoning trajectory, which can be limiting when multiple visual hypotheses or competing evidence regions are relevant. We propose Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning, a branch-aware latent reasoning framework that generates multiple question-conditioned latent visual branches as soft hypotheses over image tokens. To train these branches, our method uses bounding-box evidence annotations to build target evidence representations and introduces a soft contrastive branch-evidence alignment objective. This objective encourages evidence-relevant branches to align with annotated visual regions while contrasting them against negative evidence. We instantiate our method on Qwen2.5-VL backbones and train it with standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on perception-intensive visual reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves overall improvements over the corresponding backbone and single-path latent reasoning baselines at both 3B and 7B scales.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning，在 Qwen2.5-VL 上以多分支方式生成条件于问题的 latent 视觉假设（图像 token 上的软分支），并用边界框证据标注构造目标证据表示，通过软对比的分支—证据对齐目标训练分支，在感知密集型视觉推理基准上取得相对骨干与单路径 latent 推理基线的整体提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接针对「多种 latent 假设与视觉证据筛选」：把单条线性 latent 轨迹扩展为多分支软假设，并用证据对齐监督分配分支贡献，可供核查分支是否真正承载不同证据、以及对齐目标与答案使用之间的关系。
